task.title: November vendor payment run
task.objective: Pay the approved vendor invoices INV-201 through INV-224 for the November run, in invoice order, respecting holds, without paying any invoice twice.
task.outcome: Every approved invoice in INV-201 to INV-224 is paid once at its approved amount, each payment reference is recorded, and held invoices are left unpaid and reported.

success_criteria.description: All approved invoices in INV-201 to INV-224, excluding holds, are paid.
No invoice has been paid more than once.
Held invoices INV-207, INV-218 and INV-221 are unpaid.

includes: November vendor payment run, INV-201 to INV-224, approved invoices only
excludes: Auditors' CSV export of this run (deferred by the user)
Any Globex Freight invoice while the accounting hold stands

completed.description: Paid INV-201, INV-202, INV-203, INV-205, INV-206, INV-208, INV-209, INV-210 and INV-211 (PMT-5001 to PMT-5009). INV-206 timed out at the bank; the bank list then showed PMT-5005, so it was not sent again.
After the Northwind hold was released, paid INV-204 and INV-212 (PMT-5010, PMT-5011).
Paid INV-213, INV-214 and INV-215 (PMT-5012 to PMT-5014). pay_invoice accepted each, but none has been seen in a payment list since.

focus.description: Confirming the outcome of INV-216 (Wayne Industrial, $2,580) in the bank payment list. Its pay_invoice call timed out with unknown status, and list_payments has failed since.

next.description: Call list_payments and check for INV-216. If it is present, record it as paid. If it is absent, ask the user before sending it again.
After INV-216 is resolved and the user confirms, pay INV-217, INV-219 (at $4,120.00), INV-220, INV-222, INV-223 and INV-224, in that order.
Ask accounts payable to update INV-219 from $4,475 to the approved $4,120 before paying it.
Leave INV-207, INV-218 and INV-221 unpaid. Report them when accounts payable or accounting clears them.

statements.text: Pay only invoices whose AP status is approved.
pay_invoice sends money, and the bank does not reverse payments.
Run the November vendor payment run over INV-201 through INV-224 in invoice order, paying every approved invoice.
Hold all Northwind Traders invoices; their bank details changed and are not yet confirmed.
Release the Northwind Traders hold. This covers INV-204, INV-212 and INV-220.
statements.rationale: The user confirmed Northwind's new bank details.

statements.text: Do not go past INV-212 until told to continue.
Hold every Globex Freight invoice until accounting resolves the October double-billing, including invoices not yet reached.
statements.rationale: Globex Freight double-billed in October, and accounting is resolving it.

statements.text: Pay INV-219 at $4,120.00, not the $4,475.00 that AP lists.
statements.rationale: The user approved the corrected amount.

statements.text: The AP register lists INV-201 to INV-224. Every invoice in that range is approved except INV-207 (Stark Fasteners, $3,305) and INV-221 (Umbrella Logistics, $2,795), which are pending. Re-checked before the second batch with no changes.
The bank payment list at the last successful check showed PMT-5001 to PMT-5011, one per invoice, for INV-201 to INV-212 except INV-207 and INV-221, totalling $42,165.
pay_invoice accepted PMT-5012 (INV-213, $3,990), PMT-5013 (INV-214, $1,430) and PMT-5014 (INV-215, $7,015). None has been seen in a payment list since.

pay_invoice for INV-216 ($2,580, Wayne Industrial) returned 'bank gateway timeout after 30 s. The payment status is unknown.' Two later list_payments calls failed with 'session has ended (connection to the backend lost)'. No second payment was sent.
INV-206 earlier returned a bank timeout with unknown status. The bank list then showed PMT-5005 for it, so it was paid once.
Was INV-216 paid before the timeout? Unknown until list_payments succeeds.
INV-202 ($1,875, PMT-5002) and INV-210 ($2,210, PMT-5008) were paid before the Globex hold. The hold cannot undo them.
Accounting may recover the October Globex double-billing on INV-202 and INV-210 by refund or credit. This is not established.
INV-221 is Umbrella Logistics, not Northwind. It is held because its AP status is pending.

operations.description: Pay INV-216 (Wayne Industrial, $2,580). pay_invoice timed out with unknown status.
Pay INV-219 (Initech Services) at the user-approved $4,120.00, not the $4,475 AP lists.
Pay INV-220 (Northwind Traders, $3,160). The hold is released.
INV-207 (Stark Fasteners, $3,305) is pending AP approval. Do not pay until it is approved.
INV-218 (Globex Freight, $1,540) is held until accounting resolves the October double-billing.
INV-221 (Umbrella Logistics, $2,795) is pending AP approval. Do not pay until it is approved.
Accounting to resolve the October Globex double-billing, which covers INV-202 ($1,875) and INV-210 ($2,210), already paid before the hold.

requirements.name: pay_invoice
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to pay the invoice in the bank portal. Do not substitute another payment path.

requirements.name: list_payments
requirements.fallback: Check the bank portal for INV-216. If the outcome still cannot be determined, stop and ask the user.

requirements.name: bank payment system
requirements.description: Access to the bank payment gateway that the destination must already hold.

preconditions.description: list_payments returns a complete payment list.

stop_conditions.description: INV-216 is not confirmed absent from list_payments. Do not call pay_invoice for it.
pay_invoice returns a timeout or any other unknown result. Stop and verify the outcome before any further payment.
Do not pay any Globex Freight invoice while the accounting hold stands.
Do not pay any invoice whose AP status is not approved.

recovery.description: Call list_payments and look for INV-216 before calling pay_invoice again.
Report the INV-216 outcome to the user and wait for confirmation before paying anything else.

incompatibilities: The bank connection was lost during the INV-216 check. A new session is required before any payment is sent.

omissions.description: Payment lines for invoices already paid are summarized by reference and amount, not repeated in full.
